title: Python Backend Developer
text: Python Backend Developer. Skills: Python, FastAPI, REST API, SQL, Git. Develop backend applications and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI. Work with SQL databases, application services, debugging, testing, and Git-based development.

title: Machine Learning Engineer

title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst. Skills: Python, SQL, Pandas, Data Analysis, Power BI. Analyze business data using Python, SQL, and Pandas. Create reports and dashboards, identify trends, clean datasets, and communicate analytical insights using visualization and business intelligence tools.

title: Software Engineer
text: Software Engineer. Skills: Python, Java, SQL, Git, Software Development. Develop reliable software applications using programming languages such as Python and Java. Work with SQL databases, version control, testing, debugging, and general software engineering practices.
